title: Skirmish at Cerigo Channel
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Skirmish at Cerigo Channel", at revision 1376031717, opens: "The skirmish at Cerigo Channel was a battle between a fleet of the Holy League, led by Marcantonio Colonna in absence of John of Austria, and the Ottoman armada built after the Battle of Lepanto, captained by Occhiali." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q141159575, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1572 naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
